title: PBKDF2 with low iteration count (python) — review required
description: PBKDF2 is configured with a small iteration count: hashlib.pbkdf2_hmac("sha256", pw, salt, 1000). Low effort lets attackers brute-force stolen hashes cheaply. This lexical rule flags counts under five digits; the reviewer confirms the value meets current guidance or raises it.
remediation: Raise the count to 210,000+ iterations or switch to a memory-hard function.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches small numeric counts; variable-driven counts are missed.
